# Slingsite: Image and Video Compression Tools

This website is an interactive web tool designed to help developers and designers optimize their website's performance by compressing images and videos.

## Image Compression

Learn more about image compression at [/en/image/](/en/image/)

- Upload multiple image files (JPG, PNG, WEBP, etc.)
- Configure compression settings per device type: mobile, tablet, and desktop
- Flexible sizing options: by screen percentage, number of columns, or exact pixel dimensions (width/height)
- Generate multiple optimized formats for each original image: JPG, WEBP, and AVIF
- Download individual generated files or download all files in batch

## Video Compression

Learn more about video compression at [/en/video/](/en/video/)

- Upload video files and generate optimized cover images
- Cover images are produced in JPG, WEBP, and AVIF formats
- Videos are produced in WEBM and AVIF formats for broad compatibility
- Configure compression settings per device type: mobile, tablet, and desktop
- Download individual generated files or download all files in batch

## Interaction with LLMs

- The LLM can guide users on how to use the tool, explaining the different configuration options
- The LLM can answer questions about the importance of image and video optimization for SEO and web speed, using the context of these tools
- The LLM should not attempt to perform the compressions itself but should describe the process the user needs to follow within the UI
